title: LVDB normalized member-kinematics column dictionary
missingValue: An empty field means that the value was not reported or is unavailable for that source record. It must not be interpreted as zero, false, or non-membership.

columns.label: Object key
columns.description: Stable machine-readable LVDB identifier for the dwarf galaxy or stellar system.
columns.notes: Matches the key used by the LVDB object table and object-page URL.

columns.label: Object name
columns.description: Human-readable LVDB name of the dwarf galaxy or stellar system.

columns.label: Source kind
columns.description: Broad measurement family assigned to the source dataset.
columns.notes: Current values include spectroscopy and proper_motion. This classification does not guarantee that every record contains the corresponding measurement.

columns.label: Source provider
columns.description: Identifier for the service or file format from which the source dataset was retrieved.
columns.notes: Examples include vizier, aas_iop_mrt, zenodo_zip, and gaia_tap.

columns.label: Source reference
columns.description: Literature-reference label for the source dataset.
columns.notes: Usually ends with an ADS bibcode when one is available.

columns.label: Source dataset name
columns.description: Stable configured identifier for the normalized source dataset.
columns.notes: Use together with source_provider and source_kind to identify a dataset.

columns.label: Source table
columns.description: Provider-side catalog, table, or resource identifier used for retrieval.

columns.label: Source URL
columns.description: Retrieval or landing-page URL recorded for the source dataset.
columns.notes: The URL may point to a service query, downloadable file, or archive page.

columns.label: Normalized source row
columns.description: Zero-based row index assigned while normalizing this source dataset.
columns.notes: It is a provenance locator within the normalized source and is not necessarily the row number printed in the publication.

columns.label: Source star identifier
columns.description: Star or observation identifier supplied by the source dataset.
columns.notes: Identifier namespaces are source-specific and are not guaranteed to match across datasets.

columns.label: Right ascension
columns.description: Sky right ascension supplied by the source and normalized to decimal degrees.
columns.notes: Consult the cited source for the exact reference frame and epoch.

columns.label: Declination
columns.description: Sky declination supplied by the source and normalized to decimal degrees.
columns.notes: Consult the cited source for the exact reference frame and epoch.

columns.label: Line-of-sight velocity
columns.description: Line-of-sight velocity reported for this source record.
columns.notes: Reference frame, zero point, and sign convention follow the cited source; many spectroscopy catalogs report heliocentric velocity, but this is not imposed globally.

columns.label: Line-of-sight velocity uncertainty
columns.description: Uncertainty reported for vlos_kms.
columns.notes: Usually a one-standard-deviation uncertainty; the provider definition is authoritative.

columns.label: Proper motion in right ascension
columns.description: Proper motion in right ascension using the standard cos(declination)-included quantity mu_alpha_star.
columns.notes: Equivalent to d(alpha)/dt times cos(declination). Consult the cited source for frame, epoch, and calibration details.

columns.label: Right-ascension proper-motion uncertainty
columns.description: Uncertainty reported for pmra_masyr.
columns.notes: Usually a one-standard-deviation marginal uncertainty; covariance with pmdec is not included in this public table.

columns.label: Proper motion in declination
columns.description: Proper motion in declination reported for this source record.
columns.notes: Consult the cited source for frame, epoch, and calibration details.

columns.label: Declination proper-motion uncertainty
columns.description: Uncertainty reported for pmdec_masyr.
columns.notes: Usually a one-standard-deviation marginal uncertainty; covariance with pmra is not included in this public table.

columns.label: Membership probability
columns.description: Membership probability associated with this record, normalized to the interval from 0 to 1 when available.
columns.notes: Selection models and interpretations differ across sources. A blank value is unknown, not zero.

columns.label: Membership-probability origin
columns.description: Provenance of membership_probability.
columns.notes: reported means present on this provider row; same_star means copied only when all reported values for the same source and star ID agree; seed_source means inherited by a Gaia row from its cited input record. Blank accompanies a blank probability.

columns.label: Membership flag
columns.description: Source-specific discrete membership classification associated with this record.
columns.notes: Values such as 0 and 1 must be interpreted using the cited source. A blank value is unknown and must not be treated as a non-member flag.

columns.label: Membership-flag origin
columns.description: Provenance of membership_flag.
columns.notes: reported means present on this provider row; same_star means copied only when all reported values for the same source and star ID agree; seed_source means inherited by a Gaia row from its cited input record. Blank accompanies a blank flag.

columns.label: Metallicity [Fe/H]
columns.description: Logarithmic iron abundance relative to hydrogen and the solar abundance ratio, [Fe/H].
columns.notes: Metallicity scale and analysis method follow the cited source.

columns.label: Metallicity uncertainty
columns.description: Uncertainty reported for feh.
columns.notes: Usually a one-standard-deviation uncertainty; the provider definition is authoritative.
